verdict.rationale: Floot is built around prompting an AI chat to build and change the app. Follow-up refinement is backed by element pointing and screenshot annotation for targeted changes, get_logs for diagnosing breakage, and checkpoints you can label and restore when a change goes wrong. Missing for 10: evidence that edits are scoped so they don't regress existing features (protection comes mainly from rolling back after breakage), detail on how checkpoint restores treat database state, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of iteration reliability.
